body: Before I was always on Avicus, but now i think it is getting boring. I went on today but it just didn't feel that interesting. How can I make this more interesting for me?

replies.body: The only reason i'm still here is community , hop on ts some time and make some friends , or make some in game. Makes everything a load more fun when you have  someone else to have a laugh with.

Maybe you'll respark that flame.
